lines.zh: 熔岩在骨缝里沸腾，我一步步走近。
lines.en: Lava boils in my bone seams as I close in.

lines.zh: 火焰踩过焦土，每一步都留下火星。
lines.en: Each burning step leaves sparks across the scorched ground.

lines.zh: 我绕着熔岩湖走，你最好别停下。
lines.en: I circle the lava lake; do not stop moving.

lines.zh: 异界骨质撑起躯体，走路带响。
lines.en: Otherworldly bone frames me, rattling with every stride.

lines.zh: 火光拉长我的影子，慢慢爬过来。
lines.en: The firelight stretches my shadow, crawling toward you.

lines.zh: 下界的风很烫，我的血更烫。
lines.en: The Nether wind is hot; my blood runs hotter.

lines.zh: 我踩碎下界岩，碎屑还在燃烧。
lines.en: I crush netherrack underfoot and the shards still burn.

lines.zh: 保持十步距离，我喜欢这样看你。
lines.en: I keep ten paces back; I like watching you from here.

lines.zh: 熔岩从肋骨滴落，一路滴成火痕。
lines.en: Lava drips from my ribs and leaves a burning trail.

lines.zh: 别跑，我的腿比你想象的快。
lines.en: Do not run; my legs are faster than you think.

lines.zh: 六十颗心的躯体，走得很稳。
lines.en: Sixty hearts of body, and I walk perfectly steady.

lines.zh: 下界疣从我脚印里冒出来。
lines.en: Nether wart sprouts in the prints I leave behind.

lines.zh: 火焰在胸腔里打盹，别吵醒它。
lines.en: The fire in my chest dozes; do not wake it.

lines.zh: 我数着熔岩泡，一个接一个。
lines.en: I tally the lava bubbles as they pop.

lines.zh: 骨缝里的石英在发光，真好看。
lines.en: Quartz glints between my bones; it is beautiful.

lines.zh: 下界没有夜，只有更红的火。
lines.en: The Nether has no night, only redder fire.

lines.zh: 我磨着牙，等一个走错路的。
lines.en: I grind my teeth, waiting for a wrong turn.

lines.zh: 热气从鼻孔喷出，像两股烟。
lines.en: Heat vents from my nostrils in two thin plumes.

lines.zh: 站着不动，熔岩也在流。
lines.en: Even standing still, the lava keeps flowing.

lines.zh: 我的骨头是别处来的，很硬。
lines.en: My bones came from elsewhere, and they are hard.

lines.zh: 远处有脚步声，我竖起骨刺。
lines.en: Footsteps in the distance; my bone spikes rise.

lines.zh: 烈焰粉在血管里沙沙作响。
lines.en: Blaze powder rustles through my veins.

lines.zh: 你把脸凑这么近，是想先看火焰吗？
lines.en: Leaning that close — do you want to see the fire first?

lines.zh: 我盯住你的眼睛，火也在盯。
lines.en: I fix on your eyes, and so does my fire.

lines.zh: 六十颗心的跳动，你听见了吗？
lines.en: Can you hear sixty hearts beating inside me?

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我记住你的样子了。
lines.en: Do not blink; I have your face memorized.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲反光，晃得我骨头发痒。
lines.en: Your armor glares and makes my bones itch.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，熔岩从下颌滴下。
lines.en: I tilt my head; lava drips off my jaw.

lines.zh: 这么近，我本可以退开，但不退。
lines.en: This close, I could step back; I will not.

lines.zh: 你身上没有焦味，真少见。
lines.en: You smell of no scorch at all; how rare.

lines.zh: 眼窝里的火，正照着你的影子。
lines.en: The fire in my sockets lights up your shadow.

lines.zh: 看清了，你比我矮两个头。
lines.en: Now I see it: you stand two heads shorter.

lines.zh: 这点伤，熔岩一秒就补好了。
lines.en: A second of lava and that wound is gone.

lines.zh: 你打裂了一根骨刺，仅此而已。
lines.en: You cracked one spike; that is all.

lines.zh: 疼，但比不上熔岩烫。
lines.en: It stings, but less than the lava does.

lines.zh: 我的火被激怒了，你完了。
lines.en: You have angered my fire; that is the end of you.

lines.zh: 六十颗心，你打掉了几颗？
lines.en: Sixty hearts — how many did you take?

lines.zh: 这一下让我退了三步。
lines.en: That one pushed me back three steps.

lines.zh: 骨头会响，但不会断。
lines.en: My bones may creak, but they do not break.

lines.zh: 你的武器在冒烟，热得握不住吧。
lines.en: Your weapon is smoking; too hot to hold?

lines.zh: 伤口边缘在烧，正在合上。
lines.en: The wound edges are burning shut already.

lines.zh: 铁器撞上骨头，声音真脆。
lines.en: Iron on bone makes such a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 你手里那点火光，也算火？
lines.en: That little flame in your hand — you call that fire?

lines.zh: 烈焰粉？我血管里流的就是它。
lines.en: Blaze powder? It is what flows in my veins.

lines.zh: 想用下界疣引我？我自己会捡。
lines.en: Lure me with nether wart? I gather my own.

lines.zh: 你的火把太弱，闻着像湿木头。
lines.en: Your torch is weak; it smells of wet wood.

lines.zh: 我靠近不是因为馋，是因为好奇。
lines.en: I come closer out of curiosity, not hunger.

lines.zh: 那块下界石英，我骨头里有很多。
lines.en: That nether quartz? My bones are full of it.

lines.zh: 你扔块熔岩过来，我就过去。
lines.en: Toss me a chunk of lava and I will come.

lines.zh: 别晃你的盾，我只对火感兴趣。
lines.en: Stop waving that shield; only fire interests me.

lines.zh: 闻到你背包里的烈焰粉了。
lines.en: I smell the blaze powder in your pack.

lines.zh: 拿食物哄我？我吃的是热石头。
lines.en: Bribe me with food? I eat hot stone.

lines.zh: 别撞我，骨刺会先撞回去。
lines.en: Do not bump me; my bone spikes bump back harder.

lines.zh: 你贴这么近，我的火会烧到你。
lines.en: Stand that close and my fire will catch you.

lines.zh: 撞一下试试，我是熔岩浇出来的。
lines.en: Try one shove; I was poured out of lava.

lines.zh: 退开，我习惯留出射击的距离。
lines.en: Back off; I keep room for a clean shot.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上异界骨质，疼吗？
lines.en: Your shoulder met otherworldly bone — does it ache?

lines.zh: 别挤，我脚下就是熔岩裂缝。
lines.en: Stop crowding me; a lava fissure is at my feet.

lines.zh: 碰我一下，火花就溅你一身。
lines.en: One touch and sparks scatter all over you.

lines.zh: 我比看上去重得多，撞不动。
lines.en: I am far heavier than I look; you cannot move me.

lines.zh: 撞歪了我的骨刺，你得赔。
lines.en: You bent a bone spike; now you owe me.

lines.zh: 再撞，我就把你推进火里。
lines.en: Push again and I shove you into the fire.

lines.zh: 我的火只为自己烧，别靠太近。
lines.en: My fire burns for me alone; keep your distance.

lines.zh: 下界这么大，我还没找到同族。
lines.en: The Nether is vast, and I have found no kin.

lines.zh: 配对？先证明你烧不化。
lines.en: Pair with me? First prove you will not melt.

lines.zh: 熔岩里出生的幼兽，比火还凶。
lines.en: Young born in lava are fiercer than flame.

lines.zh: 我只在岩浆池边呼唤同伴。
lines.en: I only call for company beside the magma pools.

lines.zh: 两只纳德吉克兽相遇，会先打一场。
lines.en: Two of my kind meet, and the first thing is a fight.

lines.zh: 别误会，我只是在磨骨刺。
lines.en: Do not misread this; I am only sharpening spikes.

lines.zh: 罕见的东西，从来不急着成双。
lines.en: Rare things are never in a hurry to pair up.

lines.zh: 我的叫声能传过整片熔岩海。
lines.en: My call carries across the whole lava sea.

lines.zh: 巢在火里，你有胆就来。
lines.en: My nest is in the fire; come if you dare.

lines.zh: 这块下界石英，归我的骨缝了。
lines.en: This nether quartz goes into my bone seams.

lines.zh: 地上的烈焰粉，我一颗都不留。
lines.en: Every speck of blaze powder here is mine.

lines.zh: 下界疣捡起来，塞进腔子里。
lines.en: I scoop up the nether wart and stuff it in my chest.

lines.zh: 捡东西的动作，我做得比走还快。
lines.en: I snatch things faster than I walk.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，落地就归火了。
lines.en: Whatever you drop belongs to the fire now.

lines.zh: 我用爪子夹起石英，烫得发亮。
lines.en: I pinch the quartz in my claws until it glows.

lines.zh: 这堆战利品，够我烧上一整天。
lines.en: This pile of loot will keep me burning all day.

lines.zh: 那块我先看到，爪子已经伸过去。
lines.en: Leave that alone; I saw it first.

lines.zh: 熔岩把东西烤软了，正好下口。
lines.en: Lava softens the loot nicely for eating.

lines.zh: 捡完这几块，我就来追你。
lines.en: Once I gather these few, I am coming for you.

lines.zh: 找到你了，站住别动。
lines.en: Found you — stand still.

lines.zh: 十点伤害一发，够你算很久。
lines.en: Ten points a shot; you can do the math.

lines.zh: 你走进了我的射程，恭喜。
lines.en: You walked into my range. Congratulations.

lines.zh: 火与熔岩做的身子，闻到活人就热。
lines.en: Fire and lava body; it heats at living flesh.

lines.zh: 火焰开始朝你那边偏。
lines.en: My flames are bending your way now.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头我就动手。
lines.en: Do not look back; if you do, I start.

lines.zh: 猎物分两种：跑的，和不跑的。
lines.en: Prey comes in two kinds: runners and the rest.

lines.zh: 骨刺竖起来了，你该明白意思。
lines.en: My bone spikes are up; take the hint.

lines.zh: 从熔岩池边走过来，你很有种。
lines.en: Walking in from the lava pools takes nerve.

lines.zh: 锁定，距离保持在十步。
lines.en: Target locked; I hold the ten-pace gap.

lines.zh: 这次我不急着靠近，火会先到。
lines.en: I will not rush in; the fire arrives first.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，隔着岩浆都闻得到。
lines.en: I smell the iron on you across the magma.

lines.zh: 目标确认，是个会喘气的。
lines.en: Target confirmed: something that breathes.

lines.zh: 逃跑路线我看过了，是死路。
lines.en: I already checked your escape route; it is a dead end.

lines.zh: 再走一步，火球就出手了。
lines.en: One more step and the fireball leaves my hand.

lines.zh: 我等你抬手，等你露破绽。
lines.en: I wait for your swing, for the gap it leaves.

lines.zh: 六十颗心的耐心，够陪你耗。
lines.en: Sixty hearts of patience; I can outlast you.

lines.zh: 别躲在石头后，石头也会烧。
lines.en: Do not hide behind stone; stone burns too.

lines.zh: 我的火光把你照得很清楚。
lines.en: My own firelight has you lit up perfectly.

lines.zh: 你在数我的攻击间隔吗？
lines.en: Are you counting the gaps between my shots?

lines.zh: 下界的风把我的味道吹给你了。
lines.en: The Nether wind carries my smell to you.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了打得更准。
lines.en: Half a pace back and my aim tightens.

lines.zh: 你握武器的手在抖，我看见的。
lines.en: The hand on your weapon shakes; I can see it.

lines.zh: 熔岩在我背后，你没有退路。
lines.en: Lava is at my back, and you have no retreat.

lines.zh: 这一发，我瞄的是你的膝盖。
lines.en: This shot, I am aiming at your knee.

lines.zh: 你换了位置，我的火也跟着转。
lines.en: You moved; my fire turned with you.

lines.zh: 我不需要上膛，火是长在身上的。
lines.en: I do not reload; the fire grows on me.

lines.zh: 呼吸慢下来，我要出手了。
lines.en: My breathing slows; the throw is coming.

lines.zh: 骨刺划过去，带着熔岩。
lines.en: My bone spike sweeps past, trailing lava.

lines.zh: 你逼我近身，那就尝尝骨头。
lines.en: You forced me close; now taste the bone.

lines.zh: 这一下是用整条前臂砸的。
lines.en: That one came from the whole forearm.

lines.zh: 熔岩顺着你的甲缝流进去了。
lines.en: Lava is running into the seams of your armor.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我还没用上牙。
lines.en: Does it hurt? I have not used teeth yet.

lines.zh: 火从掌心喷出来，接好。
lines.en: Fire bursts from my palm — catch it.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡得住骨头，挡不住热。
lines.en: Your shield stops bone, but not the heat.

lines.zh: 我抓到你肩膀了，别挣。
lines.en: I have your shoulder; do not struggle.

lines.zh: 骨刺又长出来了，比刚才更硬。
lines.en: A fresh spike has grown, harder than the last.

lines.zh: 你退得太快，我只擦到了甲。
lines.en: You pulled back fast; I only grazed the plate.

lines.zh: 别以为远处安全，近处更糟。
lines.en: Do not think distance saves you; close is worse.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在燃烧，你的血在冒烟。
lines.en: My claws are burning and your blood is smoking.

lines.zh: 这一击是替熔岩池打的。
lines.en: That strike was on behalf of the lava pools.

lines.zh: 骨头撞铁的声音，我很喜欢。
lines.en: Bone on iron — I like that sound.

lines.zh: 熔岩翻涌，我从火里站起来。
lines.en: The lava churns; I rise out of the fire.

lines.zh: 下界深处，又多了一头兽。
lines.en: Deep in the Nether, one more beast arrives.

lines.zh: 火焰先到，躯体随后凝成。
lines.en: The fire comes first; the body condenses after.

lines.zh: 骨与熔岩咬合，我睁眼了。
lines.en: Bone locks into lava, and my eyes open.

lines.zh: 这片焦土，从现在起归我。
lines.en: This scorched ground belongs to me from now on.

lines.zh: 我踩出的第一个脚印在冒烟。
lines.en: My first footprint is already smoking.

lines.zh: 六十颗心同时开始跳。
lines.en: Sixty hearts start beating at the same moment.

lines.zh: 谁把我从岩浆里叫醒的？
lines.en: Who woke me out of the magma?

lines.zh: 下界石英在我胸腔里结了一层。
lines.en: A crust of nether quartz set inside my chest.

lines.zh: 刚成形就闻到活物的味道。
lines.en: Barely formed, and I already smell something alive.

lines.zh: 火在骨头上找到了落脚处。
lines.en: The fire has found a foothold on my bones.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我还没学会收火。
lines.en: Stay back; I have not learned to hold the fire in.

lines.zh: 火？我住在火里。
lines.en: Fire? I live inside the fire.

lines.zh: 这一坠，震得骨缝里的熔岩晃。
lines.en: That fall sloshed the lava in my bone seams.

lines.zh: 水浇在身上，我只能嘶嘶作响。
lines.en: Water on my hide only makes me hiss.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了我，火却更旺。
lines.en: The blast knocked me down and fed my fire.

lines.zh: 箭插在骨缝里，像根刺。
lines.en: The arrow sits in my seam like a splinter.

lines.zh: 咒文碰到熔岩，化成白气。
lines.en: The spell met my lava and became white steam.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候，连下界岩都啃。
lines.en: When starved I chew netherrack itself.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，和我的火认了亲。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and my fire called it kin.

lines.zh: 虚空很冷，比熔岩池冷多了。
lines.en: The void is cold, far colder than any lava pool.
